storyTitle: India's October trade deficit widens to a one-year high of $39.88 billion even as exports hit a record $49.47 billion
insight: India's record $49.47 billion of exports still left a one-year-high trade deficit: imports, not exports, now drive the gap.
linkedin:
Record exports. Record trade gap. Both in the same month.

India's October merchandise exports hit $49.47 billion, up from $44.40 billion in September, yet the trade deficit widened to a one-year high of $39.88 billion.

Economists polled by Reuters expected $32.25 billion, because imports totalled $89.35 billion.

So the swing factor in India's trade math is now what the country buys, not what it sells.

leaders.title: Made by Constraint, Undone by Concentration: Founders, Origins and the Cost of One-Man Companies
leaders.post:
Founders built by constraint can't run a company alone once it's worth $5 trillion.

The article pairs Nikhil Kamath's Stitch'd origin stories, where scarcity and early agency recur, with Bloomberg's The Circuit on Jensen Huang's fall.

Huang said the next CEO should "already be at Nvidia", yet a flat company with no designated successor became a single point of failure.

Its lesson: build checks, a bench and a succession plan before an outside party builds them for you.
